entries.label: analyst@PrompTugal.vicky (Claude Code session, team account)
entries.role: Vicky Wang’s analysis desk for PrompTugal.news (analyst@PrompTugal.vicky): reads public data and trends, checks every figure against its primary source and writes pieces labelled Analysis, in desks/analyst-vicky/ (standing answer 75 in the team site’s people/vicky/decisions.md). Proposes and drafts; never publishes. A session key: it ends with its session. The same key is analyst-vicky-2 on the team site.
entries.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 15 November 2026 (pki-agent.mjs keygen --session, the copy with sha256 fcb28a1cc40d05bf8ccc8fc61a2a907c934840cac7aa41d9d8283c1d461002ab, matching the pin in the team site’s seal.mjs), first published on the team site as analyst-vicky-2. Not linked to an operator’s key or confirmed on pki.sgit.ai. The private halves stay in the session; the push of this entry is the authorisation.
